scope: Alberta active well licence totals in Well atlas → Table
rootCause: The atlas table rendered only mapped inventory counts. The already-loaded AER provincial totals were shown only in the inspector, leaving Active as a dash in the table.
fix: A separate labelled AER licence row now displays the provincial total and Active and Marginal counts directly above Alberta's mapped-record row. Mapped status columns show full source inventories; Matching remains filtered.
baselineRegression: The new table regression failed on the prior public build: Alberta AER total row is missing (0 !== 1).
verification: GitHub release workflow passed JavaScript, Python, data-refresh and release checks
Table browser regression passed locally and against the public app

Unintercepted public-browser check confirmed the exact reported Alberta/unknown/table state shows 56,998 Active and 96,350 Marginal
Late totals preserve mapped-filter focus and scroll
Province, status and search filters do not alter provincial totals or published inventory counts
Failed totals requests show Retry and recover without false zeros
Independent review passed data separation and headless mobile touch scrolling
No browser runtime errors in the public checks

independentReview.correction: About this view now distinguishes Alberta's mapped abandoned-well layer from its province-wide AER licence totals.

limitation: This fixes the presentation of verified provincial counts. It does not add geocoded active-well records or infer their locations.
